title: Butterflies – Apatura iris, 500 CFA francs
descriptionPlain: Description This series combines the beauty of nature and the art of minting. Each coin presents an ephemeral portrait of a butterfly, capturing its colors and shapes with extraordinary precision. A limited edition, crafted with attention to every detail, using the highest grade silver, creates a perfect piece. These coins are designed for collectors and nature lovers, making a valuable addition to any collection and a way to celebrate the diversity of the butterfly world.
